title: Microsoft Teams: streaming switchboard for NDI sources in meetings and events
summary: The briefing passes: the admin control, default state, source limit and rollout details are supported. Licensing should name the published Teams entitlement while retaining the narrower uncertainty about switchboard-specific licensing and pricing. The statement about organisation-supplied production equipment is not established by the sources checked.

claims.claim: Teams is adding a streaming switchboard for sending NDI sources from meetings and events to production software.
claims.quote: For Teams meetings and events, a new streaming switchboard will soon be available to easily manage and send NDI sources out to production software.

claims.claim: Event producers can individually select and stream up to eight NDI sources.
claims.quote: Event producers can individually select and stream up to eight NDI sources directly from a Teams meeting or event.

claims.where: What's changing; Risk assessment: Change & support; Governance guidance: At rollout
claims.claim: The switchboard is reached through More actions > Streaming > Streaming switchboard during a meeting or event.
claims.quote: To access the feature during a meeting or event, select More actions, then Streaming > Streaming switchboard.

claims.where: summary; What's changing; Scope; Governance guidance; rationale: risk
claims.claim: Administrators must enable NDI streaming for appropriate users through AllowNDIStreaming in a Teams meeting policy.
claims.quote: Admins must enable NDI streaming before users can use the feature. Enable AllowNDIStreaming for the appropriate users through the CsTeamsMeetingPolicy cmdlet.

claims.where: What's changing; Risk assessment: Security & identity; Scope; Governance guidance
claims.claim: Users must turn on production capabilities after administrators enable NDI streaming.
claims.quote: Yes. After an admin enables NDI streaming, users must turn on production capabilities in Teams.

claims.where: front matter: defaultState; Why it matters; rationale: risk; rationale: impact
claims.claim: The default state is admin-opt-in, so users without an enabled NDI policy cannot use the feature.
claims.quote: Admins must enable NDI streaming before users can use the feature.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.model; licensing.notes; summary; Cost and licensing; Open questions
claims.claim: The licensing model is unknown because no licence specific to the streaming switchboard is published.
claims.quote: Microsoft Teams can be licensed as part of qualifying Microsoft 365 offerings or as a standalone SKU.
claims.fix: Set licensing.model to included and replace the licensing notes with: 'Teams is licensed as part of qualifying Microsoft 365 offerings or as a standalone SKU. No licence or price specific to the streaming switchboard is yet published.' Use the same distinction in the summary, Cost and licensing and licensing open question; cite https://learn.microsoft.com/office365/servicedescriptions/teams-service-description.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing
claims.claim: The Learn NDI broadcast production page gives admin and user prerequisites without naming a licence.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams NDI broadcast production hardware software installed computer requirements license. Read https://learn.microsoft.com/microsoftteams/use-ndi-in-meetings in full; its policy and client prerequisites name no licence.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing; Open questions; rationale: cost
claims.claim: No switchboard-specific licence, price, charge or meter is published.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams NDI streaming switchboard licensing price requirements production software; Teams NDI switchboard licensing price. Read Learn use-ndi-in-meetings, Teams service description and Teams Premium licensing; none names a switchboard licence, price or meter.

claims.where: controls[0].note; Risk assessment: Data exposure; Governance guidance; Governance controls
claims.claim: Learn advises against enabling the NDI and SDI broadcast policy globally.
claims.quote: For the most secure solution, don't turn on this policy as a global setting.

claims.claim: The admin control is at Teams admin center > Meetings > Meeting policies > policy > Audio & video > Broadcast production with NDI and SDI hardware.
claims.quote:
go to Meetings > Meeting policies.
2. Select an existing policy or create a new one.
3. Go to the Audio & video section.
4. Turn the Broadcast production with NDI and SDI hardware toggle On.

claims.where: controls[0].api; Governance controls table; Governance guidance: At rollout
claims.claim: Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy -Identity <policy name> -AllowNDIStreaming $true enables NDI streaming on a meeting policy.
claims.quote:
### -AllowNDIStreaming
This parameter enables the use of NDI technology to capture and deliver broadcast-quality audio and video over your network.
| Type: | Boolean |
### -Identity
Specify the name of the policy being created.

claims.claim: The broadcast production meeting policy governs NDI and SDI use per user through policy assignment.
claims.quote: As an admin, you can allow your users to use NDI® and SDI for broadcast production in their meetings. To turn on NDI® and SDI broadcast features for a user, you can use the Teams admin center or PowerShell.

claims.where: Scope; Governance guidance: At rollout; Governance controls
claims.claim: Learn instructs each enabled user to turn on Production capabilities under Settings > App Permissions in their client.
claims.quote: Users with an enabled Broadcast production with NDI and SDI hardware policy must turn on Production capabilities from Settings > App Permissions in their specific client.

claims.claim: Learn states that NDI and SDI technology is supported in all locales.
claims.quote: NDI® and SDI technology is supported in all locales.

claims.claim: The Learn PowerShell guidance names ContentSharingInExternalMeetings in its introductory text but its script uses AllowNDIStreaming.
claims.quote:
You can use the -ContentSharingInExternalMeetings parameter in the CsTeamsMeetingPolicy cmdlet to enable broadcast production for your users.
Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy -Identity <policy name> -AllowNDIStreaming $true

claims.claim: The roadmap and notice describe producer-selected streams, not autonomous switchboard behaviour.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams NDI switchboard automatic. Read the roadmap, MC1521613, Learn use-ndi-in-meetings and Teams admin release-note excerpts; automatic NDI installation is documented, but no autonomous switchboard source selection or streaming is described.

claims.claim: Microsoft has not described other changes for tenants that already enabled AllowNDIStreaming.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams streaming switchboard AllowNDIStreaming existing enabled policy changes Entra group policy assignment. Read MC1521613, Learn use-ndi-in-meetings and Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy; none specifies further changes for already-enabled tenants.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Security & identity; Governance guidance: Before rollout; Open questions
claims.claim: MC1521613 says its provided source does not specify whether Entra ID group membership can manage the control.
claims.quote: The provided source does not specify whether the control can be managed through Entra ID group membership.

claims.claim: NDI production uses hardware and software the organisation supplies.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams NDI broadcast production hardware software installed computer requirements license. Read Learn use-ndi-in-meetings and Use NDI for custom layouts; they describe networked production devices but do not establish who supplies the hardware and software.
claims.fix: Remove 'NDI production itself uses hardware and software the organisation supplies;' and retain 'Microsoft has published no charge for the switchboard.'

claims.claim: AllowNDIStreaming in a Teams meeting policy is the only documented admin control for this switchboard.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams streaming switchboard AllowNDIStreaming existing enabled policy changes Entra group policy assignment; streaming switchboard NDI. Read MC1521613, Learn use-ndi-in-meetings and Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy; no separate switchboard admin control was found.
